description: In a countable first-order language, \(\theta\in\operatorname{Cn}(T)\) if and only if \(T\vdash\theta\) in the corpus natural-deduction calculus.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Theories.mem_closure_iff_derives.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} [Countable L.Symbols]
  (T : L.Theory) (φ : L.Sentence) :
  φ ∈ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Theories.consequenceClosure T ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T φ
